plans.faqSubtitle: Helpful details about token quotas and Devnuby AI subscriptions.
plans.faq1Question: How does the 5-hour token limit work?
plans.faq1Answer: The 5-hour limit is a rolling window designed to prevent burst surges while ensuring responsive model performance for everyone.
plans.faq2Question: Can I switch plans before the current period ends?
plans.faq2Answer: Yes! You can upgrade to a higher tier at any time. Your new token quotas will be applied immediately.
plans.faq3Question: Which AI models are included in the plans?
plans.faq3Answer: All plans include fast models like Gemini Flash & GPT 5.6. Pro and Max plans unlock flagship models such as Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT 6.1 Terra.
plans.faq4Answer: We support instant payments via QRIS (all e-wallets and banking apps) as well as Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, Permata) via DOKU.
